name: vipertecpro/consent
description: Ask for App Tracking Transparency on iOS and keep the user's privacy choices — analytics, ads, personalisation or your own purposes — in one cross-platform consent store, saved natively so other SDKs can read it, with events when anything changes.

bridge_functions.name: Consent.TrackingStatus
bridge_functions.description: Return the App Tracking Transparency status without prompting

bridge_functions.name: Consent.RequestTracking
bridge_functions.description: Show the App Tracking Transparency prompt and report the answer via an event

bridge_functions.name: Consent.Read
bridge_functions.description: Read the stored consent record from UserDefaults / SharedPreferences

bridge_functions.name: Consent.Write
bridge_functions.description: Store the consent record natively so it survives restarts and other SDKs can read it

info_plist.NSUserTrackingUsageDescription: Your data is used to measure ads and show ones that are relevant to you.
